narr: A deep fetch of subtropical moisture streaming over New Mexico allowed scattered to numerous showers and thunderstorms with heavy rainfall to impact parts of the region. A couple thunderstorms along the Continental Divide became strong with gusty outflow winds, frequent lightning strikes, and hail. One of the stronger storms produced a brief landspout tornado near Lake Valley, NM in San Juan County. No damage or injuries occurred with this brief storm.
ev: An unnamed road flooded approximately one-half mile east of Torreon Wash and one-mile west of Tinnian Road.
lsr: UNNAMED ROAD FLOODED. ROAD IS APPROXIMATELY 1/2 MILE EAST OF TORREON WASH AND A MILE WEST OF TINNIAN ROAD.
